title: Pyruvate kinase M2 in cancer progression, tumor microenvironment remodeling and therapeutic resistance (Review).

title: Metastatic tumor burden and the modified Glasgow Prognostic Score are independent prognostic factors in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer: A multicenter real-world study.
snippet: Metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (mTNBC) is characterized by aggressive clinical behavior, poor prognosis and limited therapeutic options. Reliable prognostic factors to guide patient stratification in this setting remain elusive.
